scope: Local-only review of the frozen fifty-window device driver, plan and test source. No device workload, router access or Oracle access was performed for this driver review. Separate native Linux evidence is in e-udp-stage-linux-gates.json.

schedule_review.group_bindings: Exact C/E reference, E/stage-full calibration and three separate stage-full contrasts each use their own five original rounds. All stage modes use the same stage ELF.

validation_review: Each window requires 1000 prewarm, 1000 warmup and 4000 measurement correct replies with zero timeout/wrong/transport/skips; frozen base validate and analyzer traffic checks remain in use.

Stage modes require integer matched_queries=6000 and prewarm_threshold=1000. Full requires four zero cut counters; each nonfull mode requires exactly its own 5000 cuts and zero other counters. Original C/E windows reject a stage sidecar.
Before/resources/after must show one process and one thread with a stable PID/start time; final.stat checks the same identity and one thread, and daemon/case network namespaces must agree.

CPU endpoints cover the post-prewarm 1000 warmup plus 4000 measurement completions: denominator5000, not matched6000. The original 100Hz accounting and compare W/four-of-five direction/min10ticks/strict median delta>8ticks gates remain unchanged.
Each comparison consumes exactly five valid rows per side sorted by original round, independently per group. Synthetic stage contrasts retain excluded-diagnostic scope.
failure_and_restore_review: The first failure stops the loop; there are no replacements or extensions. Normal valid-window pruning follows verified archive, validation and progress write.
archive_attempted is marked before the first archive call. Both a completed archive and partial first-attempt bytes are preserved; cleanup never retries that label over the first archive.
The original failure.json is written before remote stop attempts. Stop/archive/guard-stop/guard-copy failures are retained locally without masking the original exception.

Cleanup always proceeds to the safe E/F slot restoration attempt after best-effort guard handling. Slot replacement requires no active-group marker and no owned dnsmasq executable; immutable source and copied temporary hashes are verified before atomic rename.
Restoration verifies the original E/F slot hashes and production PID/start identity. An unsafe failed active-group marker is not removed to force restoration.

External monitoring must finish without failure and the guard must still be present after the last window. Guard-copy errors and any restoration/cleanup error prevent complete.json; restoration failure has its own retained record.

test_review.failure_fixture_coverage: Complete archive followed by validator exception; partial first archive failure; simultaneous stop/guard-stop/guard-copy timeouts. Fixtures check first archive bytes retained, only one case launched, original failure present before stop, E/F restore attempted, and no completion marker.

resolved_findings: A validator exception before progress previously allowed a second archive call to overwrite completed evidence. First-attempt tracking now also protects partial archive evidence.
Remote cleanup timeouts previously could bypass local failure/restore records. The original failure is now persisted first, cleanup is best-effort and all recorded cleanup errors block completion.
limits: This is a driver review, not evidence that the fifty device windows have run or passed. Artifact delivery, fresh health, per-window raw validation and postflight remain execution responsibilities.

Stage modes are deliberately excluded synthetic cumulative-path interventions. Passing this driver review or related Linux gates does not establish full44 qualification, exact C wire equivalence, additive function cost, IPC, allocation cost, candidate acceptance or deployment eligibility.
